title: Detection of closed restriction by boundary-specializing affine tests
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, D and E schemes, i:E→D a quasi-compact open immersion, and M a module sheaf over the constant A-ring on D [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Suppose M(W)=0 as an abelian group for every affine pro-etale object W of D such that evaluation at W sends epimorphisms of set sheaves to surjections, and every point of W specializes to a point in W times_D Z, where z:Z→D is the reduced closed complement of i. Then z^*M=0 for the ordinary constant-ring module pullback. No proper morphism, injectivity, finiteness, or derived functor is assumed.

source.place: Boundary-restriction proof, Steps 1 and 3: closed-localization cover and sheaf descent; inherited from the parent compactification-independence argument, not from an arbitrary-coefficient proper base-change theorem.

proof.text: Use the localization_cover construction in the proof of ringed localization to cover every ambient pro-etale object by objects over the open and affine weakly contractible boundary-specializing objects. This is the bounded affine extension followed by the finite principal-open/closed-localization cover.

Let L be closed module inverse image and P its direct image, and put N=P(L(M)). On open objects its sections vanish by the empty pullback and the sheaf axiom. On boundary objects the actual adjunction unit M(W) to N(W) is bijective; the hypothesis makes M(W) zero. Sheaf separatedness on the cover implies N=0.

Apply L to N=0 and use the invertible closed counit to obtain L(M)=0. Tensor extension along the constant coefficient isomorphism is isomorphic to inverse scalar transport, hence sends this zero object to zero.

lean.statement:
theorem isZero_closedRestriction_of_boundary_tests
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    {D E : Scheme.{u}} (i : E ⟶ D) [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact i]
    (M : proEtaleRingModules D (proEtaleConstantRing D A))
    (htest : ∀ (W : D.ProEt), IsAffine W.left →
      (∀ (F G : Sheaf (ProEt.topology D) (Type (u + 1))) (e : F ⟶ G),
        Epi e → Function.Surjective (e.hom.app (op W))) →
      (∀ x : W.left, ∃ z : ↥(pullback W.hom i.closedComplement),
        Specializes x ((pullback.fst W.hom i.closedComplement) z)) →
      IsZero (((SheafOfModules.evaluation
        ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology D)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
            (proEtaleConstantRing D A)) (op W)) ⋙
              forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} _) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj M)) :
    IsZero ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A i.closedComplement).obj M)
